test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Everywhere
solution:
The correct answer is "Nowhere."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"everywhere"** means in or to every place. (सब जगह, सर्वत्र)

 
 
• **Example**: *I’ve looked **everywhere**__, but I still can’t find it.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of the given word is **"Nowhere."**
 
• The word **"nowhere"** means not in or to any place; not anywhere. (किसी स्‍थान में या पर; कहीं नहीं)
 __
 
• **Example**: *I’m afraid there’s **nowhere**__ to stay in this village.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Somewhere: **at, in, or to a place that you do not know or do not mention by name. (स्‍थान पर/में/(को) जो आपको नहीं मालूम या जिसका नाम आप नहीं बताते; कहीं)
 
• **Little: **not big; small. (बड़ा नहीं; छोटा)
 
• **Rare: **not done, seen, happening, etc. very often. (दुर्लभ, विरल (बहुत कम किया जाने, दीखने या होने वाला))
